startup_read_status.home_latest_continuity_gearbox: TARGETED_LOOKUP_NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_EXACT_PATH; continuity retained through fresh Active-8 exact pointer only; NO_BROAD_ARCHIVE_READ

agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor executable code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only and must not become verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and should remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics only, not calibrated capability units or promotion truth.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, heartbeat count, wake count and awake time are invalid substitutes.

disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: v1 evaluates standby before rollback_required. When both authenticated control flags are true, select_gear returns N immediately and rollback R is never formed. Existing v1/v2/v2.1 tests cover N and R separately but not the simultaneous conflict, so terminal-authority ordering is undefined and rollback can be shadowed by standby.
disagreements.required_change: Define one explicit terminal-control precedence shared across v1/v2/v2.1. If rollback is the stronger safety authority, authenticated rollback must dominate standby; otherwise the contract must specify the trusted conflict-resolution authority. Add simultaneous N/R conflict tests and preserve the result through v2/v2.1 without telemetry override.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and installation/runtime identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope; secretary-derived pressure fields require per-field provenance/freshness.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events uses a per-invocation seen set and str-coerced event_id. Same evidence can be replayed under new IDs or across restart/rollback; rejected first claims can reserve identity before acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt. v2.1 can re-mint verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified even when inherited v2 promotion eligibility is false.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 may only project AcceptedExperienceReceipt.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe while remaining non-Experience.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with frozen metric definitions and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

disagreements.finding: v1 and v2 normalize risk with str(risk).strip().upper(), while NONE is a valid lowest-risk value. Python None therefore becomes the literal string NONE and is accepted as explicit no-risk.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one canonical typed RiskLevel boundary shared by v1/v2/v2.1; null/missing/non-string risk fails closed and cannot alias to explicit NONE.

disagreements.finding: GearboxV2Decision carries checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score, but GearboxV21Decision drops them.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must re-project all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or bind an immutable exact inherited-decision fingerprint/reference.

statistical_risks: Undefined rollback-versus-standby precedence can censor rollback observations and bias terminal/recovery statistics depending only on flag co-occurrence and check order.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest and complete assigned-workload accounting.
proposed_tests: GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-CONFLICT-194: set rollback_required=true and standby=true under otherwise clean inputs; terminal result must follow one explicit precommitted authority precedence and may not depend on incidental if-statement ordering.
GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-CROSSPATH-195: the same simultaneous terminal conflict must resolve identically in v1, v2 and v2.1, with no secretary/pressure/anti-thrash rewrite.
GB21-ROLLBACK-STANDBY-TELEMETRY-196: simultaneous terminal conflict plus malformed or extreme nonessential telemetry must still reach the authenticated terminal conflict-resolution path.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without a trusted provenance envelope.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL: forged high verified_progress_density must remain observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay must produce one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING: raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures must not be treated as equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

blocks: claim that rollback/standby terminal conflict has a defined safe authority precedence
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
claim that v2.1 preserves inherited v2 safety semantics while safety metadata are absent
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

One explicit terminal-control precedence is shared by v1/v2/v2.1. Simultaneous authenticated rollback and standby cannot be resolved accidentally by source-code ordering; the chosen safety rule is preserved through all overlays.
Secretary signal provenance/freshness is replay-resistant and fresh authority is projected from an exact trusted authority decision.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted denominator/sample/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression passes.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

Accepted event identity and evidence lineage are durable and rollback-resistant; exact replay NO_OPs, same evidence/new ID cannot re-credit, same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT, and rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and require evidence-bound operational acceptance receipts for authoritative speed/progress accounting.
Credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are excluded from capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance/promotion claims.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency using the same versioned metric manifest, exposure/censoring and complete assigned-workload coverage.
Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS, Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION and P_base READ_ONLY remain preserved regardless of v2/v2.1 candidate vetoes.
